overview: Sabi Solar is a remote energy monitoring app that lets users track solar generation versus grid consumption across multiple properties. It features real-time gauges, metric cards, analytics charts, and property management in a dark mobile-first UI.
features: 3-page swipeable onboarding with email/phone OTP login
Real-time circular energy gauge with Solar/Grid toggle
Metric cards: kWh consumed, kVA capacity, CO2 reduction
24-hour bar chart auto-refreshing every 30s with mock data
Add Property and Add Solar forms with QR scan button
Notification tray with excessive consumption alerts
Dark Navy + Emerald Green mobile-first UI
